title: Burst run at 50K works with EMR managed scaling
purpose: 50K run of the bounded pipeline, only after experiment A succeeded and with explicit human approval, observing EMR managed scaling within the 3-node cap: requested, provisioned and released capacity over time. Doubles as the instructor-approved 10K versus 50K comparison of time, utilization and cost.

environment.note: Terraform output region; no AWS call is made by this manifest.

command_notes: The pipeline script ALSO needs --approve-50k and a succeeded 10K record under reports/pipeline/10k/. That flag is deliberately NOT in this command: the human adds it only after recording the decision in a human-gate file.

HUMAN APPROVAL EDIT (same step as setting approved and approved_by): append to the command array "--approve-50k", "--dblp-xml", "<file>", "--dtd", "<file>", "--enrichment-dir", "<dir>" (the script exits 2 without the first three). Appending arguments to this array is a manifest edit by the human, not a change by experiment-engineer.

scripts/run-experiment.sh runs this command verbatim (no extra arguments) and does not export its run id. The pipeline script therefore generates its own run id; its record is reports/pipeline/50k/<generated id>/run.json (use that id as --run-id of the collectors). The run-experiment.sh run id names only reports/experiments/<id>/<run>/.
Core count: the default --core-count 1 lets managed scaling grow to 2 core/task nodes (the 3-node cap).
scripts/run-experiment.sh refuses unless approved is true and approved_by is non-empty, and refuses a dirty tree: commit the raw results of experiment A first.

cost_estimate.basis: INFRA-CONTRACTS.md section 10: one 50K run is about $2.47 of EMR

dataset_snapshot.notes: 10K plus seeded fill from the policy-1 100K selection; use of that selection is flagged PENDING human approval in the dataset manifest

metrics_to_collect: emr-list-instance-groups:RequestedInstanceCount,RunningInstanceCount over time (sample_resources.py, 30 s): requested, provisioned, released
hadoop-counters and spark-event-log as in experiment A
cost-explorer:daily UnblendedCost by SERVICE, credits excluded
stop_conditions: no succeeded 10K record (experiment A) exists: do not start
no recorded human approval (--approve-50k decision) exists: do not start
cost reaches the cost cap (4.00 USD)
EMR reports more than 3 nodes in total: stop and report
reproduction: After A succeeded and the human recorded approval: bash scripts/run-experiment.sh exp-b-burst-50k --run-id <token> (human has set approved/approved_by and appended --approve-50k and the three input arguments to command); collectors for the window with the pipeline's generated run id; analysis: emr_capacity.py, scale_comparison.py (10K versus 50K)
